caption: The drawing depicts two objects against a plain, off-white background. In the upper right corner, there is a red, slightly rusted, three-sided metal object with a semi-cylindrical protrusion in front and a perforated pattern on the slanted top surface. Below and centrally placed is a rectangular depiction of a puppet theater façade labeled “PUNCH AND JUDY BANK” in yellow letters on a gold background. The theater structure is primarily dark brown with red and yellow accents, and blue curtains frame the stage. Inside the stage area, two puppet-like figures are present: the left figure has a red and yellow cap and a protruding chin, while the right figure has a yellow scarf or hat and a red dress, holding a stick. The base of the theater shows a yellow, leafy decorative pattern. There is also faint handwriting in the upper left corner that reads "Build up #2" and a small printed signature or name “ALF BRUSETTI” in the bottom right corner.
title: Punch and Judy Bank
